subject.title: Follow-up: optimize fallback order + add model-input config guardrail

question: Which fallback-ranking policy and configured-model input capability contract should OpenClaw enforce for this issue?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but ranking fallbacks is a product policy choice and tightening model input validation can change accepted custom-provider config behavior.

options.title: Keep broad tracker open
options.body: Use this issue for the benchmark-backed fallback policy while resolving the focused input guardrail contract through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/50287.

options.title: Split fallback policy again
options.body: Reopen or sponsor a narrower fallback-order issue and leave this broad tracker only as historical context once that canonical item exists.

options.title: Accept configured ordering
options.body: Document that operators own explicit fallback order and only pursue the validation guardrail, leaving benchmark ranking out of core for now.

recommendation.title: Keep broad tracker open
recommendation.body: Use this issue for the benchmark-backed fallback policy while resolving the focused input guardrail contract through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/50287.
